title: [FEATURE] Menu Bar Only Mode (Hide Dock Icon Option)
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

**Feature Request: Menu Bar Only Mode (Hide Dock Icon Option)**

**Current Behavior:**
Claude Desktop always shows an icon in the Dock, even when minimized 
or running in the background.

### Proposed Solution

**Requested Feature:**
Add a user preference to hide the Dock icon and run Claude exclusively 
from the menu bar, similar to apps like:
- Raycast
- Alfred
- Rectangle
- Bartender

**Proposed Implementation:**
Settings → General → "Show in Dock" (checkbox, enabled by default)
- When disabled: App only appears in menu bar
- When enabled: Current behavior (shows in Dock)

**Use Case:**
For users who:
- Use Claude frequently throughout the day
- Prefer minimal Dock clutter
- Access the app primarily through keyboard shortcuts or menu bar

**Additional Context:**
This would also provide a workaround for the current quit bug (issue #14951) 
where Cmd+Q doesn't properly close the app, since menu bar apps typically 
have a "Quit" option in their menu.

**Platform:** macOS
**Priority:** Enhancement/Nice-to-have

top_comments.author: maximedupre
top_comments.body: YES 🥹 The ChatGPT desktop app does this: you can quit the app (such that it disappears from the dock), but the "menu bar process" remains open and you can give it prompts with the hotkey.

top_comments.author: Netherwarlord
top_comments.body: This feels 100% needed! Claude is honestly the only BIG model i like to use, and it leaves me trying to close it to get rid of clutter in my dock, than trying to hotkey it 10 minutes later with no response. It seriously kills my workflow and I end up back with m365 Copilot, which tells me half the time that it simply "can't discuss that topic"

top_comments.author: flallnatural
top_comments.body: I was surprised to find out that this feature isn't built into Claude. Definitely much needed. The menu bar is a much cleaner setup, especially when you can use the CAPS key as a voice prompt (this feature I love btw).
